text_en: In Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a centurion of the Italian Cohort, as it was called.
text_cn: 在凯撒勒雅有一个人，名叫科尔乃略，是所谓意大利营的百夫长。

text_en: He was a devout man who feared God with all his household; he gave alms generously to the people and prayed constantly to God.
text_cn: 他同他的全家，是虔诚而敬畏天主的人，对百姓慷慨好施，又常向天主祈祷。

text_en: One afternoon at about three o’clock he had a vision in which he clearly saw an angel of God coming in and saying to him, “Cornelius. ”
text_cn: 有一天，大约第九时辰，他在异像中，清楚看见天主的一位天使进来，到他跟前向他说：“科尔乃略！”

text_en: He stared at him in terror and said, “What is it, Lord? ” He answered, “Your prayers and your alms have ascended as a memorial before God.
text_cn: 他注目看天使，就惊惶害怕说：“主，有什么事？”天使回答说：“你的祈祷和施舍已升到天主面前，获得纪念。

text_en: Now send men to Joppa for a certain Simon who is called Peter;
text_cn: 你现在打发人往约培去，请号称伯多禄的一位西满来。

text_en: he is lodging with Simon, a tanner, whose house is by the seaside. ”
text_cn: 这人客居在一个名叫西满的皮匠家里，他的房子靠着海。”

text_en: When the angel who spoke to him had left, he called two of his slaves and a devout soldier from the ranks of those who served him,
text_cn: 向他说话的天使一走，他便叫来了两个家仆和常护卫自己的一个虔诚兵士，

text_en: and after telling them everything, he sent them to Joppa.
text_cn: 把一切事告诉了他们，就打发他们往约培去了。

text_en: About noon the next day, as they were on their journey and approaching the city, Peter went up on the roof to pray.
text_cn: 第二天，他们行路将近城的时候，约在第六个时辰，伯多禄上了屋顶祈祷。

text_en: He became hungry and wanted something to eat; and while it was being prepared, he fell into a trance.
text_cn: 他那时饿了，愿意进食；正在人预备饭的时候，他就神魂超拔了。

text_en: He saw the heaven opened and something like a large sheet coming down, being lowered to the ground by its four corners.
text_cn: 他看见天开了，降下一个器皿，好像一块大布，系着四角，缒到地上，

text_en: In it were all kinds of four-footed creatures and reptiles and birds of the air.
text_cn: 里面有各种四足兽、地上的爬虫和天空的飞鸟。

text_en: Then he heard a voice saying, “Get up, Peter; kill and eat. ”
text_cn: 有声音向他说：“伯多禄！起来，宰了，吃罢！”

text_en: But Peter said, “By no means, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is profane or unclean. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄却答说：“主，绝对不可！因为我从来没有吃过一样污秽和不洁之物。”

text_en: The voice said to him again, a second time, “What God has made clean, you must not call profane. ”
text_cn: 声音第二次又向他说：“天主称为洁净的，你不可称为污秽！”

text_en: This happened three times, and the thing was suddenly taken up to heaven.
text_cn: 这事一连发生了三次，那器皿随即撤回天上去了。

text_en: Now while Peter was greatly puzzled about what to make of the vision that he had seen, suddenly the men sent by Cornelius appeared. They were asking for Simon’s house and were standing by the gate.
text_cn: 伯多禄正在猜想他所见的异像有什么意思的时候，看，科尔乃略打发来的人，已查问到西满的家，站在门前。

text_en: They called out to ask whether Simon, who was called Peter, was staying there.
text_cn: 他们喊着询问：号称伯多禄的西满是否住在这里。

text_en: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Look, three men are searching for you.
text_cn: 伯多禄还在沉思那异像时，圣神说：“看，有三个人找你。

text_en: Now get up, go down, and go with them without hesitation; for I have sent them. ”
text_cn: 起来，下去，同他们一起去罢！不要疑惑，因为是我打发他们来的。”

text_en: So Peter went down to the men and said, “I am the one you are looking for; what is the reason for your coming? ”
text_cn: 伯多禄下来向那些人说：“看，我就是你们所找的人。你们来这里做什么？”

text_en: They answered, “Cornelius, a centurion, an upright and God-fearing man, who is well spoken of by the whole Jewish nation, was directed by a holy angel to send for you to come to his house and to hear what you have to say. ”
text_cn: 他们答说：“科尔乃略百夫长是个正义和敬畏天主的人，也受全犹太人民的称誉；他蒙圣天使指示，请你到他家去，听你讲道。”

text_en: So Peter invited them in and gave them lodging. The next day he got up and went with them, and some of the believers from Joppa accompanied him.
text_cn: 伯多禄于是请他们进来住下，第二天起来，便同他们一齐去了；还有几个约培的兄弟陪着他。

text_en: The following day they came to Caesarea. Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.
text_cn: 次日，他到了凯撒勒雅。那时，科尔乃略召集了自己的亲戚和密友，等候他们来。

text_en: On Peter’s arrival Cornelius met him, and falling at his feet, worshiped him.
text_cn: 当伯多禄进来的时候，科尔乃略去迎接他，跪伏在他脚前叩拜。

text_en: But Peter made him get up, saying, “Stand up; I am only a mortal. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄拉他起来说：“起来！我自己也是个人。”

text_en: And as he talked with him, he went in and found that many had assembled;
text_cn: 就同他谈着话进去了，看见有许多人聚集在那里，

text_en: and he said to them, “You yourselves know that it is unlawful for a Jew to associate with or to visit a Gentile; but God has shown me that I should not call anyone profane or unclean.
text_cn: 便对他们说：“你们都知道犹太人是不准同外邦人交接来往的；但是，天主指示给我，没有一个可说是污秽或不洁的人。

text_en: So when I was sent for, I came without objection. Now may I ask why you sent for me? ”
text_cn: 为此，我一被请，毫不犹豫地就来了。请问：你们请我来是为什么原故？”

text_en: Cornelius replied, “Four days ago at this very hour, at three o’clock, I was praying in my house when suddenly a man in dazzling clothes stood before me.
text_cn: 科尔乃略说：“从此时起，四天以前，第九时辰，我在我房中祈祷时，忽然有位穿华丽衣服的人站在我面前，

text_en: He said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer has been heard and your alms have been remembered before God.
text_cn: 说：科尔乃略，你的祈祷蒙了垂允，你的施舍在天主前得到记念。

text_en: Send therefore to Joppa and ask for Simon, who is called Peter; he is staying in the home of Simon, a tanner, by the sea. ’
text_cn: 所以，你要打发人往约培去，叫号称伯多禄的西满来，他客居在靠近海的皮匠西满家里。

text_en: Therefore I sent for you immediately, and you have been kind enough to come. So now all of us are here in the presence of God to listen to all that the Lord has commanded you to say. ”
text_cn: 我就立刻打发人到你那里去了。你来的真好！现今我们众人都在天主前，要听主所吩咐你的一切。”

text_en: Then Peter began to speak to them: “I truly understand that God shows no partiality,
text_cn: 伯多禄遂开口说：“我真正明白了：天主是不看情面的，

text_en: but in every nation anyone who fears him and does what is right is acceptable to him.
text_cn: 凡在各民族中，敬畏他而又履行正义的人，都是他所中悦的。

text_en: You know the message he sent to the people of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all.
text_cn: 他藉耶稣基督──他原是万民的主──宣讲了和平的喜讯，把这道先传给以色列子民。

text_en: That message spread throughout Judea, beginning in Galilee after the baptism that John announced:
text_cn: 你们都知道：在若翰宣讲洗礼以后，从加里肋亚开始，在全犹太所发生的事：

text_en: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power; how he went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.
text_cn: 天主怎样以圣神和德能傅了纳匝肋的耶稣， 使他巡行各处，施恩行善，治好一切受魔鬼压制的人，因为天主同他在一起。

text_en: We are witnesses to all that he did both in Judea and in Jerusalem. They put him to death by hanging him on a tree;
text_cn: 我们就是他在犹太人地域和耶路撒冷所行一切的见证人。他们却把他悬在木架上，杀死了。

text_en: but God raised him on the third day and allowed him to appear,
text_cn: 第三天，天主使他复活了，叫他显现出来，

text_en: not to all the people but to us who were chosen by God as witnesses, and who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
text_cn: 不是给所有的百姓，而是给天主所预拣的见证人，就是给我们这些在他从死者中复活后，与他同食共饮的人。

text_en: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that he is the one ordained by God as judge of the living and the dead.
text_cn: 他吩咐我们向百姓讲道，指证他就是天主所立的生者与死者的判官。

text_en: All the prophets testify about him that everyone who believes in him receives forgiveness of sins through his name. ”
text_cn: 一切先知都为他作证：凡信他的人，赖他的名字都要获得罪赦。”

text_en: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit fell upon all who heard the word.
text_cn: 伯多禄还在讲这些话的时候，圣神降在所有听道的人身上。

text_en: The circumcised believers who had come with Peter were astounded that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out even on the Gentiles,
text_cn: 那些受过割损与伯多禄同来的信徒，都惊讶圣神的恩惠也倾注在外邦人身上，

text_en: for they heard them speaking in tongues and extolling God. Then Peter said,
text_cn: 因为听见他们说各种语言，并颂扬天主。那时，伯多禄就发言说：

text_en: “Can anyone withhold the water for baptizing these people who have received the Holy Spirit just as we have? ”
text_cn: “这些人既领受了圣神，和我们一样，谁能阻止他们不受水洗呢？”

text_en: So he ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they invited him to stay for several days.
text_cn: 遂吩咐人以耶稣基督的名给他们付洗。以后，他们求伯多禄再住了几天。
